summary: Iter45 worker agreement gate fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 new iter45 pytest + 47/47 combined regression (iter45 + iter29 gigs router + iter44 VA gating) all PASS. Frontend Playwright E2E from worker login → /crew/gigs/{id} → click accept-gig-btn → modal opens → 3 rules text verified verbatim → submit DISABLED initial / with only checkbox / with checkbox+wrong name / with only correct name (no checkbox) → submit ENABLED with checkbox+name (case + leading/trailing whitespace tolerant via '  worker demo  ') → 'Never mind' (worker-agreement-cancel) closes modal without submitting → re-open + submit succeeds → modal auto-closes → toast 'Request sent — waiting for HCOB approval' shown → accept-gig-btn removed and 'Request pending HCOB approval' panel shown with Cancel-my-request control. All data-testids present and behaving correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Name comparison uses .trim().toLowerCase() on both sides on the frontend AND backend — matches spec; whitespace + case tolerant. Confirmed by both unit test (typed_name='  worker demo  ') and Playwright UI test.

Modal backdrop click handler `onClick={() => !busy && setAgreementOpen(false)}` allows users to dismiss the modal by clicking outside even though there's a 'Never mind' button — this is acceptable UX since clicking outside === cancel.
Edge case verified: duplicate accept on the same gig is blocked with 400 'already' — does not re-trigger the agreement gate, which is correct (agreement only logs on first successful request).

Edge case verified via test_accept_blocked_for_unverified_worker (iter29): an unverified worker hitting /accept with a fully valid agreement payload is still rejected with 403 — profile/ID gates fire BEFORE agreement audit doc is written. Defense-in-depth working correctly.
Admin (non-worker) hitting GET /api/worker/my-agreements correctly returns 403 — role guard in place on audit endpoint.
Audit doc captures IP, version, verbatim rules, worker_name — all confirmed via test_accept_succeeds_with_valid_agreement_and_writes_audit.
Frontend disables both submit and cancel buttons while `busy` is true (preventing double-submit) — good pattern.
